activeVersion.name: Do not name a dealership for an unauthenticated caller
activeVersion.description: Audit Log here already omits tenant_id when Resolve Tenant returns null, which is the correct pattern -- but it never returned null. An anonymous POST to /webhook/finance-calc is refused inside Calculate Equity & Tier by RETURNING an error item rather than throwing, so the item flowed on and the sole_configured_tenant fallback named ALBA CARS and stamped a stranger's REJECTED row into the dealership's audit trail. The fallback is now skipped when the request arrived over the public webhook and Verify JWT produced no user: source becomes 'unauthenticated', tenant null, and the audit row falls to the quarantine tenant. The tool path, the webhook path WITH a valid JWT, and every figure in the calculation are untouched.
